subject: general
question: Which of the following physical quantities has same SI unit as that of work?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Energy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Work:__

 __
 
• Work is the product of force and displacement. Work transfers energy from one place to another, or one form to another.
 
• The SI unit of work is the joule (J).
 
• Joule is equal to the work done by a force of one Newton acting through one meter.
 
• Dimension Formula for Joule is [M¹L²T⁻²].
 
• 1 Joule = 107 ergs.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Energy:__

 __
 
• The SI unit of energy is the joule (the symbol for it is J).​
 
 
 
• Power:__
 
 
• It is defined as the work per unit of time.
 
• Its S.I unit of power is Watt.
